# The card owing 300.00 USD paid 500.00 from C, as in
# a_usd_card_owing_300_paid_500_from_c.txt, but the card's split valued at the
# 1.40 of the day throughout: 700.00.
#
# The card's split repays 300.00 at the 1.35 the card's owed cost basis cost,
# 405.00, and the 200.00 moved onto its credit came out of C at the 1.30 C's
# cost basis cost, 260.00: 665.00. Valued at 700.00, `$residual$` would state
# 50.00 realized where the repayment realized 15.00, so it is refused, and the
# refusal states the figure.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-01-20 * "Travel charged to the card"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Travel 405.00 CAD
	Liabilities:USD Card -300.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "-405.00"
		guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000008"

2034-02-01 * "Pay 500.00 USD onto the card from C, valued at the day's rate"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD C -500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-650.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000003"
	Liabilities:USD Card 500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "700.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000008"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
